note: Amtrak routes that offer sleeping accommodations (Roomette/Bedroom). The gtfs-sleeper adapter keeps only feed routes whose route_long_name / route_short_name / route_id matches one of these (case/space/punctuation-insensitive). Day corridors (Acela, Northeast Regional, state-supported services) are intentionally excluded. Edit this list to add/remove sleeper routes; no code change needed. Removed 2026-09: "Capitol Limited" and "Silver Star" — the feed no longer carries either, and the Floridian, which it does carry (Miami – Washington – Pittsburgh – Cleveland – Chicago, 46 stops), runs the corridors they used to. Found by `probe-gtfs --verify-allowlists`, which reported them as matching nothing; left in place they would have made that warning permanent and hidden the next real drift.
